what_this_lane_repairs.defect: replayPromotion() built its pick from {confidence} alone, so calculateScore saw an empty market and no sport and skipped applyPromotionModifiers (market-family multipliers, the family score cap, the unsupported-sport cap). Replay also scored with the caller's policy rather than the weights and minimumScore the decision was recorded with. An eager-path NBA player prop persisted best-bets suppressed at 60.15 replayed qualified at 70.76.
what_this_lane_repairs.repair: Both promotion snapshot writers persist scoringContext {market, sport} via promotionScoringContextForPick(), the helper calculateScore now reads. replayPromotion() scores from it. New replayRecordedPromotion() replays a pick_promotion_history payload using only the row's snapshot, scoring context and saved policy, and reports score/status agreement; rows lacking a snapshot, scoring context, saved policy or recorded score are reported not-reproducible with a named reason.
what_this_lane_repairs.residual: replayPromotion(snapshot, policy) still accepts a caller policy (its counterfactual contract); fidelity to the recorded decision is replayRecordedPromotion()'s job. Rows written before this change are not reproducible (scoring-context-missing), by design.

Full workspace unit suite on this tree.
